metadata.description: A simple task management web application with user authentication
metadata.extra_instructions: Use React for the frontend, Express for the backend, and PostgreSQL for the database. Follow REST API conventions.

priority_guidelines.description: Priority is determined by: 1) Setup/infrastructure first, 2) Backend before frontend, 3) Core features before enhancements

tasks.name: Initialize project structure
tasks.description: Create the basic project structure with separate frontend and backend directories, package.json files, and basic configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Both directories have package.json with appropriate dependencies

tasks.name: Set up database schema
tasks.description: Create PostgreSQL database schema with users and tasks tables, including migrations.
acceptance_criteria: Users table with id, email, password_hash, created_at
Tasks table with id, user_id, title, description, status, due_date, created_at
Foreign key relationship between tasks and users

tasks.name: Implement user registration endpoint
tasks.description: Create POST /api/auth/register endpoint that accepts email and password, validates input, hashes password, and creates user in database.
acceptance_criteria: Password is hashed with bcrypt before storage
Returns 201 with user data (no password) on success

tasks.name: Implement user login endpoint
tasks.description: Create POST /api/auth/login endpoint that validates credentials and returns JWT token.

tasks.name: Create authentication middleware
tasks.description: Create middleware that validates JWT token and attaches user to request object.
acceptance_criteria: Middleware extracts token from Authorization header
Returns 401 if token is missing or invalid
Can be applied to protected routes

tasks.name: Implement CRUD endpoints for tasks
tasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks. All endpoints require authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Users can only access their own tasks

tasks.name: Add task filtering and sorting
tasks.description: Extend GET /api/tasks to support filtering by status and due_date, and sorting by various fields.

tasks.name: Create login and registration pages
tasks.description: Build React components for user login and registration with form validation.
acceptance_criteria: Login page with email and password fields
Registration page with email, password, and confirm password
Stores JWT token in localStorage on success
Shows loading state during API calls

tasks.name: Create task list dashboard
tasks.description: Build the main dashboard showing user's tasks with ability to filter, sort, and paginate.
acceptance_criteria: Shows task title, status, and due date
Protected route (redirects to login if not authenticated)

tasks.name: Create task create/edit form
tasks.description: Build modal or page for creating and editing tasks with all fields.
acceptance_criteria: Form with title, description, status, and due date fields
Works for both create and edit modes

tasks.name: Add task delete confirmation
tasks.description: Add delete button with confirmation dialog to prevent accidental deletions.
acceptance_criteria: Delete button on each task card

tasks.name: Add end-to-end tests
tasks.description: Create Playwright or Cypress tests for critical user flows.
